valuation.sensitivity_note: Historical sensitivity varies constant FCFF growth. Forward sensitivity shifts every segment annual revenue growth by -2, 0 or +2 percentage points while recalculating reinvestment.

central_model.business_profile: AI-led semiconductor growth with a recurring infrastructure-software cash-flow business
central_model.investment_lens: Quality-growth analysis with GARP price discipline; quality constrained by customer concentration and acquisition accounting
central_model.reason: An explicit AI/non-AI/software FCFF model represents the changing mix better than the historical-average policy screen. Selection follows business economics, not whichever style label gives the highest value. Central assumptions remain provisional because long-run AI margins and cash taxes are not independently established.

evidence.finding: AI growth and near-term guidance require a distinct AI operating forecast.
Software profitability and rising end-customer concentration require separate treatment of margins and execution risk.

central_model.distinction: Business profile determines model suitability. Investment lens does not set growth or margins. Valuation is conditional on the explicit operating forecast; the policy result is a separate investment screen. GARP is a price discipline, not an intrinsic company category.

operating_expectations.definition: For each assumed segment operating margin, solve a common constant revenue growth rate that reprices the entire DCF to the supplied price. This consolidated hurdle holds the starting segment revenue mix fixed; it is not the AI-led central forecast. Capital intensity, working capital, corporate costs, discount rate and terminal reinvestment are held to the referenced model. Each row is a different conditional path; revenue, margin and FCFF cannot be solved independently from one price.
operating_expectations.period_note: Milestones are rolling twelve-month periods ending on the base month/day, not fiscal-year forecasts. The terminal value starts only after the full forecast horizon; 2030 is not treated as a separate exit.

business_review.analyst_coverage: One identifiable research provider, not a consensus dataset. No verified like-for-like 2030/2035 revenue, margin and FCFF analyst consensus was obtained.
business_review.management_coverage: Verified release guidance covers the next quarter. Longer-term AI ambitions discussed by analysts are labeled secondary reports; no verified management 2030/2035 operating forecast is claimed.
business_review.competition: Custom silicon competes with general-purpose GPU ecosystems, rival ASIC design partners and customers internalizing more design work. Power, advanced packaging, customer financing and AI monetization constrain delivery. Market size does not establish achievable share or profit.
business_review.capital_allocation_conclusion: Mixed evidence: dividends and repurchases fit within annual FCF, but diluted shares still increased. VMware added a profitable software platform, while the cash-and-stock cost and debt exposure make standalone acquisition returns essential. Consolidated returns do not establish a deal IRR.
